mapper.sql: content_id, category, subtype, title, primary_text, secondary_text, author, work, source_type, source_url, source_locator, source_original, language, translator_editor, tags, tone, char_count, recommended_weight, copyright_status, review_status, risk_notes, active, content_version, created_at, updated_at

if.test: query != null and query.category != null and query.category != ''
query != null and query.reviewStatus != null and query.reviewStatus != ''
query != null and query.active != null and query.active
query != null and query.active != null and !query.active
query != null and query.keyword != null and query.keyword != ''

mapper.select: SELECT FROM pet_saying_content WHERE active = 1 AND review_status = '可发布' ORDER BY category ASC, content_id ASC

SELECT FROM pet_saying_content
ORDER BY updated_at DESC, content_id ASC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT DISTINCT category FROM pet_saying_content WHERE category IS NOT NULL AND category != '' ORDER BY category ASC
SELECT content_version FROM pet_saying_content WHERE content_version IS NOT NULL AND content_version != '' ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pet_saying_content ( content_id, category, subtype, title, primary_text, secondary_text, author, work, source_type, source_url, source_locator, source_original, language, translator_editor, tags, tone, char_count, recommended_weight, copyright_status, review_status, risk_notes, active, content_version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{contentId}, #{category}, #{subtype}, #{title}, #{primaryText}, #{secondaryText}, #{author}, #{work}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceUrl}, #{sourceLocator}, #{sourceOriginal}, #{language}, #{translatorEditor}, #{tags}, #{tone}, #{charCount}, #{recommendedWeight}, #{copyrightStatus}, #{reviewStatus}, #{riskNotes}, #{active}, #{contentVersion}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT(content_id) DO UPDATE SET category = excluded.category, subtype = excluded.subtype, title = excluded.title, primary_text = excluded.primary_text, secondary_text = excluded.secondary_text, author = excluded.author, work = excluded.work, source_type = excluded.source_type, source_url = excluded.source_url, source_locator = excluded.source_locator, source_original = excluded.source_original, language = excluded.language, translator_editor = excluded.translator_editor, tags = excluded.tags, tone = excluded.tone, char_count = excluded.char_count, recommended_weight = excluded.recommended_weight, copyright_status = excluded.copyright_status, review_status = excluded.review_status, risk_notes = excluded.risk_notes, active = excluded.active, content_version = excluded.content_version, updated_at = excluded.updated_at
